name: expense-tracker
description: Gmail-sourced expense tracker: iPhone app (Expo) with an on-device L0-L4 parsing cascade, dedupe and categorization, plus a small API for the rules pack and the opt-in AI fallback.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @expense/core && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @expense/core && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @expense/core && npm run typecheck -w @expense/core && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w mobile
